# ARCA Server — LLM Context

## What is this project?
ARCA Server is a full-stack Argentine electronic invoicing system (facturación electrónica) that integrates with ARCA (formerly AFIP) web services. It allows businesses to issue invoices (Facturas A/B/C), credit notes, debit notes, query taxpayer data, and generate ARCA certificates — all through ARCA's official SOAP-based APIs. UI and user-facing API messages are in Spanish (voseo).

## Architecture
- **Backend:** Express 5.2 (TypeScript 6), Prisma 7 (PostgreSQL, driver adapter @prisma/adapter-pg), Zod 4, arca-cert
- **Frontend:** React 19.2, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS 4 (@tailwindcss/vite, no postcss.config), React Hook Form 7
- **Runtime:** Node `^22.12.0 || >=24.0.0` (declared in `engines` of the root, backend and frontend package.json; the SDKs need Node >= 22.12 and load via require(esm)). Docker images use node:22-alpine
- **Facturación:** @ramiidv/arca-facturacion ^7.0.3 (`ArcaFacturacion`; ESM-only, loaded via require(esm)) — WSFEv1, QR, uncertain-result recovery. Whole API camelCase; rejections throw `ArcaRechazoError` (since 7.0). The SDK also supports CAEA and WSFEX, but the server does NOT expose them: it issues WSFEv1 CAE vouchers (A/B/C invoices, NC, ND) and only reads WSFEX status
- **Padrón:** @ramiidv/arca-padron ^0.9.2 — A4 (full), A10 (basic), A13, A100, constancia; typed ArcaPadronServiceError; condicionIvaDesdePadron; `metadata` on personas
- **Constatación:** @ramiidv/arca-cdc ^0.8.3 — WSCDC verify comprobantes, camelCase (cbteModo + cuitEmisor required)
- **FECRED:** @ramiidv/arca-fecred ^0.8.2 — Factura de Crédito Electrónica MiPyME (WSFECRED); open enums in responses
- **MTXCA:** @ramiidv/arca-mtxca ^0.8.3 — Facturación con detalle de artículos (WSMTXCA, XSD field names, condicionIVAReceptor required, half-even rounding, urlQR)
- **SIRE:** @ramiidv/arca-sire ^0.7.3 — IVA retention certificates C2005 (emitirCertificado, anularCertificado, status with headerInfo); auth faults (incl. BAD_SERVICE, CANT_VERIFY_DATA since 0.7.1) → ArcaAuthError (503)
- **Agro:** @ramiidv/arca-agro ^0.8.3 — Carta de Porte (WSCPE), Liquidaciones (WSLPG). WSCTG was removed (repealed by RG 5017/2021)
- **Empleados:** @ramiidv/arca-empleados ^0.6.1 — "Ingreso masivo de relaciones laborales" fixed-width TXT (130 positions, ISO-8859-1). Not F935
- **Common:** @ramiidv/arca-common ^0.10.1 — WSAA (one `WsaaClient` shared by all SDKs here), FileTicketStorage, SOAP client with legacy TLS fallback, strict formatDate, validators
- **Certificates:** arca-cert handles automated ARCA certificate generation/renewal via portal login

## Key Files

### Backend
- `backend/src/index.ts` — Express app with `trust proxy` = TRUST_PROXY, Helmet (CSP, HSTS, frame-ancestors:none), CORS (CORS_ORIGIN list), rate limiting (200/15min global, 20/15min auth), body limit 1MB. Public: GET /api/health and /api/auth (login, registration-status, first register); /api/invoices, /api/clients, /api/afip behind authMiddleware
- `backend/src/config/index.ts` — Environment config (loads backend/.env). JWT_SECRET and DATABASE_URL are required (no defaults, throws on missing). `corsOrigin` (CORS_ORIGIN, comma-separated, default http://localhost:5173), `trustProxy` (`parseTrustProxy(TRUST_PROXY)`: unset/empty/false/0 → false, true, a hop count or an IP/subnet list), `afip.certPath`/`afip.keyPath` (AFIP_CERT_PATH/AFIP_KEY_PATH resolved against cwd, default backend/certs/cert.crt and key.key), `afip.ticketsDir` (AFIP_TICKETS_DIR, default backend/certs/tickets), `afip.recoveryDelayMs` (AFIP_RECOVERY_DELAY_MS, default 3000)
- `backend/src/services/arca.service.ts` — All 7 service instances (ArcaFacturacion, ArcaPadron, ArcaCdc, ArcaFecred, ArcaMtxca, ArcaSire, ArcaAgro) built lazily on first use from one `ArcaSdkConfig` (cuit, cert, key, production, `FileTicketStorage(AFIP_TICKETS_DIR)`, `onEvent`) plus ONE shared `WsaaClient` (`createWsaaClient` from arca-common, passed as `wsaa`). WsaaClient validates cert/key at construction (ArcaValidationError); missing cert files → AppError 503, so the server still boots without certs. The Proxy binds methods to the real instance (SDKs use #private fields). ArcaEmpleados is stateless (no SOAP). `reloadArca()` recreates all instances with the configured CUIT and environment (new WsaaClient, clears login cooldowns) — there is no hot environment/CUIT switch; `resetWsaaCooldown()` calls `wsaa.resetLoginCooldown()`; `probarCertificado(production)` tests the cert against WSAA; `ambienteArca()` ('production' | 'testing' from AFIP_PRODUCTION) and `nombreAmbiente()` are shared by index.ts and routes/afip.ts
- `backend/src/services/invoice.service.ts` — createInvoice / createNotaCredito / createNotaDebito share `emitir()`: reserve number (ultimoComprobante + 1) and date (formatDate(arca.wsaa.now())), `armarComprobante` → intento, persist Invoice with resultado "P" + `emision` JSON BEFORE sending, then facturar/notaCredito/notaDebito. Uncertain → recuperarComprobante (autorizado → "A"; no_emitido → resend once with same cbteNro+fecha; conflicto → "C" with `emision.encontrado` in camelCase; otherwise stays "P"). Rejection (`ArcaRechazoError` from facturar/notaCredito/notaDebito, or from recuperarComprobante when the number exists with the attempt's data but rejected) → row deleted, AppError 422 "ARCA rechazó el comprobante: <code>: <msg>" with `errors`/`details` = observaciones (same status/shape as ArcaWSFEError). On resend, ArcaRechazoError or ArcaWSFEError (except 6xx) → deleted/422; a 10016 by number (`requiereRecuperacion(error)`, as ArcaRechazoError or ArcaWSFEError) is uncertain, not a rejection; ArcaAuthError (incl. WSFE 600/601 since 6.1), 602, network → stays "P". `recuperarFactura(id)` retries recovery. Per-(ptoVta,cbteTipo) in-process lock (single backend instance only: it does not serialize across replicas); new emissions blocked (409) while one is pending. QR via `arca.urlQR(result)`. `concepto` defaults to 1 (Productos), service dates only with 2/3. condicionIva from body or client (RG 5616); with docTipo 99 left undefined so the SDK sends 5. `getInvoiceStats(hoy?)`: approved only; totalCount (all vouchers), invoiceCount/creditNoteCount/debitNoteCount (NOTA_CREDITO_MAP / NOTA_DEBITO_MAP values are notes, the rest invoices); totalAmount/monthlyAmount = invoices + ND − NC; monthlyInvoices (invoices only), monthlyCreditNotes, monthlyDebitNotes and monthlyAmount filter cbteFch by the current Argentina month (formatDate)
- `backend/src/lib/prisma.ts` — Single shared Prisma 7 client with PrismaPg driver adapter
- `backend/src/middleware/auth.ts` — JWT Bearer + API key (SHA-256 hashed, looked up by hash, X-API-Key header; acts with its owner's role). `adminMiddleware` (403 unless role admin) guards generate-cert, renew-cert and user creation
- `backend/src/middleware/errorHandler.ts` — Spanish messages. AppError(status, message, isOperational, details?, errors?) → `{ error, details?, errors? }`; `mensajesArca(errors)` → "code: msg; ..."; `motivosRechazo(ArcaRechazoError)` → errors, or observaciones when there are none (shared with invoice.service). ZodError → 400 "Datos inválidos: path: message; ..." + `details` (issues); malformed JSON → 400; body over the limit → 413; Prisma P2002 409, P2034 409, P2025 404. instanceof checks ordered most-specific first: AppError, Prisma, ArcaValidationError (400 + field/details), ArcaResultadoInciertoExpo / ArcaResultadoIncierto (502, uncertain: true, recuperacion), ArcaConflictoExpo (409, details { id, enviado, respuesta }), ArcaTicketVigenteError (503) before ArcaAuthError (503 + retryable, faultCode, blocked = permanent WSAA error cms./coe./xml./wsn. → use POST /afip/wsaa-reset; message differs for WSFE 600/601 ticket rejection), ArcaPadronServiceError (reason: inexistente 404, inactiva 422, id_invalido 400, no_autorizado 502) and ArcaWSFEError (422, error "ARCA rechazó la solicitud: <code>: <msg>", `errors`) and ArcaAgroServiceError with uncertain (502) and ArcaRechazoError (422, resultado R of MTXCA/FECRED/SIRE incl. ArcaSireServiceError: `code`, `operacion`, `errors`, `observaciones`, error "ARCA rechazó la operación: <code>: <msg>") before ArcaServiceError (422 + errors), ArcaSoapError (502/504 with faultCode/faultString/uncertain/upstreamStatus; parseSoapFault fallback; responseBody/faultDetail never exposed), ArcaResponseError incl. ArcaAgroResponseError (502 + uncertain), ArcaPadronError (502), ArcaSerializationError (400), ArcaError (400), ArcaCertError, ZodError
- `backend/src/routes/afip.ts` — GET /config ({ environment, cuit, puntoVenta }, no ARCA call), ARCA params, cert management (generate-cert and renew-cert share `rutaCertificado`: admin-only; reject with 400 a CUIT other than AFIP_CUIT or an environment other than the active one (AFIP_PRODUCTION), 503 without AFIP_CUIT, 409 while another generation is in progress (in-process flag); write AFIP_CERT_PATH/AFIP_KEY_PATH via unique temp files + rename (temp files removed on failure; I/O errors → 500 with a Spanish cause from the errno, the paths only go to the log), then `reloadArca()`; response { alias, cuit, environment, message } without server paths; cert-info reads AFIP_CERT_PATH ({ notBefore, notAfter, daysLeft, expired } or null); test-cert defaults to the active environment), padrón (3), CDC (3), FECRED (5), MTXCA (3), SIRE (sire-status, sire-emitir + alias sire-retencion, POST sire-anular), Agro (agro-status, agro-cpe-autorizar, agro-lpg-autorizar), Empleados (empleados-generar, ?formato=txt download, fechaReferencia), comprobante, cotizacion, puntos-venta, last-voucher, status ({ wsfe, wsfex }), wsaa-reset. All responses use the SDKs' camelCase names. Route/query params validated in the route; bodies validated by the SDKs (ArcaValidationError)
- `backend/src/routes/invoices.ts` — POST / (create; concepto default 1; observations stored locally only), POST /nota-credito, POST /nota-debito (201 approved, 202 pending/conflict, 422 rejected by ARCA), POST /:id/recuperar, GET / (query validated with Zod: page ≥ 1, limit 1–100 (`paginacionSchema` from lib/paginacion.ts), cbteTipo/clientId positive ints, resultado A/P/C, from/to YYYYMMDD; invalid → 400). VALID_CBTE_TIPOS from CbteTipo, VALID_IVA_IDS from IVA_RATES, GET /stats, GET /:id
- `backend/src/routes/auth.ts` — GET registration-status (public, `{ open }` = no users yet); POST register: public only while there are no users (first user = admin, returns token; count+create in a Serializable transaction), afterwards admin-only (403 otherwise; optional `role` user|admin; returns `{ user }` without token); login (JWT), me, api-keys CRUD (scoped to the caller, max 5 per user, SHA-256 hashed, keyHint for display)
- `backend/src/routes/clients.ts` — CRUD with search by name/docNumber, page/limit validated with `paginacionSchema` (400 if invalid), delete protection (fails if client has invoices)
- `backend/prisma/schema.prisma` — User, ApiKey (key=hash, keyHint=mask), Client, Invoice (qrUrl, resultado A/P/C, emision Json, monId, monCotiz), InvoiceItem. Migration `20261101120000_add_invoice_emision`
- `backend/prisma.config.ts` — Prisma 7 config (@ts-nocheck, executed by Prisma CLI not tsc)
- `backend/tests/` — arca-sdk.test.ts (SDK API + integration gated by ARCA_INTEGRATION=1), afip-routes.e2e.test.ts (real arca.service + SDKs, ARCA mocked with mockFetchWith from @ramiidv/arca-common/testing; also /config, /cert-info, /test-cert default env, cert generation success/rejections/409 in progress and admin guard, FECRED resultado R → 422 ARCA_RECHAZO, /puntos-venta with WSFE 602 → []), arca-service.test.ts (boot without certs), auth.routes.test.ts (closed registration, concurrent first registrations, admin guard, cert write error without paths), listados.routes.test.ts (page/limit/filter validation), config.test.ts (parseTrustProxy), errorHandler.test.ts (incl. ArcaRechazoError, ArcaSireServiceError, motivosRechazo), invoice.service.test.ts (uncertain → recover incl. 10016 by number, ArcaRechazoError → 422 on send/recovery/resend, concepto default, stats, mocked SDK + in-memory Prisma), afip-empleados.route.test.ts (?formato=txt)
- `backend/vitest.config.ts` — 60s test timeout

### Frontend
- `frontend/src/App.tsx` — 14 routes (2 public: login/register, 12 protected). Login shows "create the admin account" only while registration is open; Register is disabled once users exist
- `frontend/src/api/client.ts` — Axios client with 30s timeout (120s for emissions/recovery), auto Bearer token, auto-logout on 401. Functions unwrap the backend `{ success, data }` envelope and map paginated lists to `{ invoices|clients, total, page, totalPages }`. getInvoiceStats maps invoiceCount, credit/debit note counts, totalAmount, monthly counts/amount and pendingCount. Timeouts: TIMEOUT_EMISION (120s: emissions, recovery, generate/renew cert) and TIMEOUT_MEDIO (60s: constatar, test-cert). getArcaConfig (cached GET /afip/config), getRegistrationStatus, createUser (admin). Includes recuperarFactura, constatarComprobante (camelCase ConstatarInput: cbteModo, cuitEmisor...), getCotizacion ({ monId, monCotiz, fchCotiz }), getAfipStatus ({ wsfe, wsfex }), resetWsaa, FECRED (idCtaCte), SIRE (emitirCertificadoSire, anularCertificadoSire), generarArchivoEmpleados / descargarArchivoEmpleados
- `frontend/src/utils/errors.ts` — getApiErrorMessage() extracts err.response.data.error over axios err.message and appends ARCA `errors[]` ("code: msg"), Zod `details[]` ("path: message"), soapFault and an uncertain warning
- `frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts` — formatCurrency (ARS), formatDate (YYYYMMDD → DD/MM/YYYY), formatCbteTipo, formatFullInvoiceNumber, formatDocType
- `frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx` — Sticky header with glassmorphism blur, skip-to-content link, user menu with avatar initial
- `frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx` — 5 sections: General, Facturación (Facturas, Nueva Factura, NC/ND), Gestión (Clientes, Nuevo Cliente), ARCA (Consultar Cbte., Parámetros), Sistema (API Keys, Configuración). Footer shows the server's active environment (amber dot Homologación / green Producción) and CUIT from GET /api/afip/config; no version string
- `frontend/src/components/InvoiceStatusBadge.tsx` — badge-green (A Aprobada), badge-yellow (P Pendiente/incierta), badge-red (C Conflicto, R Rechazada)
- `frontend/src/pages/InvoiceList.tsx` — Filters: estado, tipo, desde/hasta and cliente (client search via GET /clients?search=, up to 100, debounced; `?clientId=` preselects it, `?page=`/`?clientId=` that are not positive integers are ignored). Stale responses are discarded when filters change; load errors shown with getApiErrorMessage
- `frontend/src/components/RecuperarFacturaButton.tsx` — POST /invoices/:id/recuperar with toasts; used in InvoiceList rows and InvoiceDetail banner
- `frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` — Greeting by time of day, 4 stat cards (invoices only with "+ N NC · M ND" below, total amount = invoices + ND − NC, this month's invoices with NC/ND below, this month's amount net of NC), ARCA status (hidden on mobile), recent invoices table (columns hidden on mobile), stats by type sidebar
- `frontend/src/pages/NewInvoice.tsx` — Type-aware form: Factura A (forces CUIT, shows alert), Factura B (all doc types), Factura C (hides IVA selector, no IVA in totals). Voucher class from CLASE_CBTE (types/index.ts). Receptor IVA condition options filtered by voucher class with CONDICIONES_IVA_POR_CLASE (same as the SDK's resolverCbteTipo, RG 5616: A 1/6/13/16 (RECEPTORES_CLASE_A, 10243); B 4/5/7/8/9/10/15; C any). 0% VAT (id 3) counts as Neto Gravado. Dynamic punto de venta from getPuntosVenta(). Concepto default 1; service dates only shown for concepto 2/3. Observaciones are local notes (not sent to ARCA)
- `frontend/src/pages/NewNotaCredDeb.tsx` — NC/ND tabs, invoice search, type auto-inferred from original. Linked from InvoiceDetail with ?facturaId=
- `frontend/src/pages/NewClient.tsx` — CUIT lookup button (consultarCuit → GET /afip/contribuyente/:cuit = padron.getPersona, A4) auto-fills name, address, IVA condition (condicionIvaSugerida)
- `frontend/src/pages/ConsultaComprobante.tsx` — Query comprobante in ARCA by PV + type + number (camelCase resultGet: importes, CAE/CAEA, dates, observaciones) and constatación form (WSCDC: cbteModo, cuitEmisor, ...), prefillable from the queried comprobante
- `frontend/src/pages/AfipParams.tsx` — 7 tabs (comprobantes, documentos, iva, cond. IVA, conceptos, monedas, tributos), lazy-loaded, items `{ id, desc, fchDesde?, fchHasta? }`, monedas tab has cotización lookup
- `frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx` — Cert status (expiry, days left, color-coded, active environment from GET /afip/config), generate/renew (admins only; CUIT prefilled with AFIP_CUIT, environment fixed to the server's active one), verify cert against WSAA in the active environment, WSFEv1/WSFEX status (appserver/dbserver/authserver), "Reintentar autenticación" (POST /afip/wsaa-reset), "Crear Usuario" (admins), app info
- `frontend/src/main.tsx` — Toaster with custom render: dismiss button (✕) on every toast, error toasts last 10s, success 5s
- `frontend/src/index.css` — @import "tailwindcss", @utility directives (btn-primary/secondary/danger, card, input, label, select, table-header/cell, stat-card, empty-state, badge-green/red/yellow, skip-link). Touch targets 44px for pointer:coarse, touch-manipulation, prefers-reduced-motion, focus-visible, print styles, custom scrollbar
- `frontend/src/types/index.ts` — Invoice (with qrUrl), Client, InvoiceItem, InvoiceStats; ARCA types in the SDKs' camelCase (ParamAfip, PuntoVenta, Cotizacion, UltimoComprobante, ComprobanteAfip, ConstatarInput/Result, ServerStatus, ServicioStatus, ArcaStatus); CBTE_TIPOS, DOC_TIPOS (99 = "Sin identificar / Consumidor Final"), IVA_ALICUOTAS, IVA_CONDITIONS, CONDICIONES_IVA_POR_CLASE, CLASE_CBTE, TIPOS_FACTURA (1, 6, 11), NOMBRE_AMBIENTE constants (numbers from the SDKs' CbteTipo/CondicionIva: the frontend does not depend on the SDKs); ArcaConfig, AmbienteArca

## ARCA Integration (modular packages)

### @ramiidv/arca-common ^0.10.1
- **WSAA** with `ticketStorage` (this project: one shared `FileTicketStorage` at AFIP_TICKETS_DIR and one shared `WsaaClient`). Without storage every restart ends in `ArcaTicketVigenteError` during WSAA's retention window (2 min in production, 10 in homologación, per the WSAA manual). Since 0.8 `ArcaTicketVigenteError` is `retryable: true` with `retryAfterMs` (the client waits `alreadyAuthenticatedCooldownMs` before asking WSAA again); errorHandler answers 503 with `Retry-After`
- WsaaClient validates cert/key at construction (ArcaValidationError). After a non-retryable login error (`cms.*`, `coe.notAuthorized`, `xml.*`, `wsn.*` except `wsn.unavailable`) the service is blocked until `resetLoginCooldown(service?)`, `clearTicket` or `clearAllTickets` (`permanentErrorCooldownMs`, default Infinity); transient errors keep the 60s `loginErrorCooldownMs`
- `ArcaSdkBase` (all SDK main classes) rejects a shared `wsaa` from another environment; all SDK configs extend `ArcaSdkConfig` (= `ArcaBaseConfig` + `wsaa`, `signal`, `endpoints.wsaa`)
- `status()`/`statusOf` → `ServiceStatus` = `{ ok: true, status } | { ok: false, error, status? }`; `ok` is false if any server is not `OK`
- SOAP transport with legacy TLS fallback (`legacyTls: "auto"`): production WSFEv1/WSCDC (servicios1.afip.gov.ar, 1024-bit DH) fail on Node >= 17 without it
- Since 0.8 `dec()` rounds half-even (Round Half Even, the manuals' criterion) in every SDK; the server's own `roundTwo` uses `roundHalfEven` too so stored item amounts match what is sent
- `formatDate` is strict: only `Date`, `YYYYMMDD` or `YYYY-MM-DD` (existing dates); `Date` uses the Argentina calendar date. The `parseAfipDate`/`afipSoapCall`/`*Cuil` aliases were removed in 0.9 (use `parseArcaDate`/`arcaSoapCall`/`*Cuit`)
- Errors: ArcaError > ArcaAuthError (faultCode, statusCode, retryable) > ArcaTicketVigenteError; ArcaSoapError (statusCode, faultCode, faultString, uncertain, aborted, responseBody, faultDetail); ArcaServiceError (errors[]) > ArcaRechazoError (code ARCA_RECHAZO, `operacion`, `errors`, `observaciones`: every SDK throws it when ARCA answers resultado "R"); ArcaValidationError (field, details); ArcaResponseError (uncertain). `instanceof` works across package copies (code-based)

### @ramiidv/arca-facturacion ^7.0.3
- `Arca` → `ArcaFacturacion`; removed `serverStatus()`/`serverStatusExpo()` (use `status()` → `{ wsfe, wsfex }` ServiceStatus), `extractCAE`, static `formatDate`/`calcularTotales`, `toDateString`
- **camelCase everywhere**: `consultarComprobante` → `{ resultGet: { cbteFch?, impTotal, impIva, docTipo, docNro, codAutorizacion?, resultado?, emisionTipo?, iva?[], tributos?[], cbtesAsoc?[], opcionales?[], observaciones?[] }, events? }` (lists are plain arrays; many fields optional since 6.1); param tables `{ id, desc, fchDesde?, fchHasta? }` (condiciones IVA `{ id, desc, cmpClase? }`), puntos de venta `{ nro, emisionTipo?, bloqueado?, fchBaja? }`, `getCotizacion` → `{ monId, monCotiz, fchCotiz }`
- **WSFEv1** — facturar / notaCredito / notaDebito (never retried) always return an authorized FacturaResult (no `aprobada`, `cae` required); resultado R → `ArcaRechazoError` (motives in `observaciones`). armarComprobante (pure, returns request/importes/intento), recuperarComprobante(intento) → autorizado | no_emitido | conflicto (throws ArcaRechazoError if the number exists with the attempt's data but rejected; ArcaResponseError on an unknown Resultado), requiereRecuperacion(error) (10016 by number, 703 CAEA)
- 6.2 adds the WSFEv1 v4.8 / WSFEX 3.1.1 rules (receptor condition per class incl. B and 49 (10243), 10015, 10040 associable types (`CBTES_ASOCIABLES`), 10068, 10069, FCE notes 10151/10156-10158/10183, compradores, seguros de caución, WSFEX 1600-1605/1754/1755/2047) and `NOTA_CREDITO_MAP`/`NOTA_DEBITO_MAP` now also map notes, receipts and other class types (derived from 10040; FCE notes of the same kind excluded). B to No Categorizado with other tributos but no tributo 13 is no longer rejected (10283 only observes)
- 6.1 validations: class A/M (and 34, 39, 60, 63, 51-54) require docTipo 80; NC/ND need cbtesAsoc or periodoAsoc; B to No Categorizado needs tributo 13; FCE needs `vtoPago` (new top-level option, independent of `servicio`); raw API sums checked. `Moneda.GUARANIES`='029', `BOLIVIANOS`='031' (were swapped)
- `condicionIva` required when docTipo != 99 (RG 5616); with docTipo 99 the simplified API sends 5 (only the raw API demands it explicitly)
- Errors: WSFE 600/601 and WSFEX 1000/1001 → `ArcaAuthError` (retryable false, faultCode '600', ArcaWSFEError in cause; ticket not cleared). 602 is still ArcaWSFEError. `ArcaResultadoIncierto` / `ArcaResultadoInciertoExpo` for uncertain emissions; new `ArcaConflictoExpo` (WSFEX Id already used by another request: not authorized). Malformed query responses → `ArcaResponseError` (re-exported)
- **QR** — `arca.urlQR(facturaResult)`, `generarUrlQR`, `urlQRDesdeFactura`; base URL https://www.arca.gob.ar/fe/qr/

### @ramiidv/arca-padron ^0.9.2
- **A4** getPersona, **A10** getPersonaBasic, A13, A100, constancia. Business faults → `ArcaPadronServiceError` with `reason` (inexistente, inactiva, id_invalido, no_autorizado, otro); "No existe persona con ese Id" in the constancia is now `inexistente` too
- `status()` → one `ServiceStatus` per service (a5, a4, a10, a13, a100); the route serializes the Error as a message
- `condicionIvaDesdePadron(persona)` → `{ condicionIva | null, motivo }` (used for `condicionIvaSugerida`); warns about `errorConstancia` even when determined; impuesto 33 → null; with `errorConstancia` and no IVA/monotributo tax the motivo says ARCA didn't issue the constancia
- `TipoDomicilio.LEGAL_REAL` ('LEGAL/REAL') and `LOCALES_Y_ESTABLECIMIENTOS` (`LEGAL`/`REAL`/`EstadoClave.LIMITADO` removed in 0.9)
- Personas carry `metadata` ({ fechaHora, servidor }); batch constancia returns per-item errors; low-level `WsAuth` is camelCase

### @ramiidv/arca-cdc ^0.8.3
- `constatar(input)` camelCase: `cbteModo` (CAE|CAI|CAEA), `cuitEmisor`, `ptoVta`, `cbteTipo`, `cbteNro`, `cbteFch`, `impTotal`, `codAutorizacion`, `docTipoReceptor?`, `docNroReceptor?`, `opcionales?` → `{ resultado, fchProceso, cmpResp?, observaciones, eventos }` (`events` until 0.7). Resultado R = functional rejection, returned (constatar is a query: observaciones; cmpResp may be missing); ARCA `Errors` → ArcaServiceError; unexpected shape → ArcaResponseError
- `getTiposCbte()` → `[{ id, desc }]`
- 0.7 validates locally 101 (cbteFch >= 2013), 113/114 (A, A con leyenda and MiPyME need docTipoReceptor 80 + number), 117, 118

### @ramiidv/arca-fecred ^0.8.2
- `consultarMontoObligadoRecepcion({ cuitConsultada, fechaEmision })` (`obligado` optional), `consultarCtasCtes({ rol, ... })` → `{ ctasCtes, nroPagina?, hayMas?, observaciones }` (response enums are open strings)
- `aceptarFECred({ idCtaCte, saldoAceptado, codMoneda, cotizacionMonedaUlt, ... })`, `rechazarFECred({ idCtaCte, motivos[] })`; idCtaCte = `{ codCtaCte }` | `{ idFactura }`. Resultado R → `ArcaRechazoError` (route answers 422)
- `wscommon_*` faults → ArcaAuthError; ArcaServiceError messages include the method
- 0.7 (manual v2.0.3): aceptarFECred local rules 12013/12012/2016/12007/12008/2007, duplicate codes 2003/2013/3001/4002, retention porcentaje 0 < P < 100; `consultarCtaCte().ctaCte` optional; `consultarObligadoRecepcion` removed in 0.8 (the server uses consultarMontoObligadoRecepcion)

### @ramiidv/arca-mtxca ^0.8.3
- `autorizar(ComprobanteType)` with XSD names (codigoTipoComprobante, numeroPuntoVenta, importeSubtotal, codigoMoneda, condicionIVAReceptor (required), items[], subtotalesIVA[]...). Rejection (resultado R) throws `ArcaRechazoError` (since 0.8) → 422 via errorHandler; approved (A/O) → route adds `urlQR`
- Round Half Even; FCE: fechaVencimientoPago required in 201/206; `informarComprobanteCAEA` requires `fechaHoraGen` (rule 754); `onEvento` config
- 0.7 (manual v0.25.8): local rules for FCE datos adicionales (21/22/27), FCE associates (cuit = emisor), compradores 420-429, No Categorizado 145/342, CAEA codes; `autorizar` passes the emisor CUIT itself

### @ramiidv/arca-sire ^0.7.3
- Only `emitirCertificado(params)` → `{ certificadoNro, codigoSeguridad }`, `anularCertificado({ numeroCertificado, motivoAnulacion, codigoTrazabilidad? })`, `status()` (+ `headerInfo`). No query operations exist
- Date rules validated locally (fechaRetencion >= 2019-12-01, fechaComprobante <= fechaRetencion); token faults → ArcaAuthError (since 0.6 the cached ticket is NOT cleared); `soapenv:Client` faults → ArcaSireServiceError (extends ArcaRechazoError since 0.7, with `operacion` 'emitir' | 'anular')

### @ramiidv/arca-agro ^0.8.3
- **WSCPE** (`agro.cpe`, requests follow the XSD: cabecera, origen, datosCarga, destino, transporte...) and **WSLPG** (`agro.lpg.liquidacionAutorizar({ liquidacion, ... })`). No `agro.ctg`
- `status()` → `{ cpe, lpg }` with ServiceStatus
- PDF errors (WSCPE 550, WSLPG 1021) don't cancel the operation: returned in `advertencias` (no `pdf`). `ArcaAgroServiceError.uncertain` = errors AND a result (CTG/COE) → route answers 502 + uncertain. New recovery queries (cgConsultarXNroOrden, ajusteXNroOrdenConsultar...)
- 0.7 adds the WSCPE derivados granarios circuit, `preservarIntervinientes` on CPE edits, WSLPG `lpgAnularContraDocumento` (`liquidacionAnular` removed in 0.8), anticipos, contrato ops, `cgInformarCalidad` and secondary liquidation (`lsg*`), plus manual validations. The server only exposes `autorizarCPEAutomotor` and `liquidacionAutorizar`

### @ramiidv/arca-empleados ^0.6.1
- `new ArcaEmpleados({ strict?, fechaReferencia? })` (no cuitEmpleador) with `alta` (AT), `baja` (BT, fechaFin), `modificacion` (MR), `novedad` (any code)
- `fechaInicio` required for every movement; unknown properties rejected (ArcaValidationError) in both modes; alta with fechaInicio > 90 days after `fechaReferencia` rejected in strict mode
- `generar()` → `{ contenido, lineas, encoding, buffer, resumen }`; `buffer` is ISO-8859-1 with CRLF

Key methods used in this project:
- errorHandler: `ArcaTicketVigenteError` → 503 + `retryable: true`, `retryAfterMs` and `Retry-After` (seconds) when the SDK reports the wait
- `arca.ultimoComprobante` + `arca.armarComprobante` + `arca.facturar/notaCredito/notaDebito` + `arca.recuperarComprobante` — safe emission flow
- `arca.urlQR(result)` — QR URL; `formatDate(arca.wsaa.now())` — invoice date with ARCA's clock
- `padron.getPersona(cuit)` + `condicionIvaDesdePadron`, `padron.getPersonaBasic(cuit)`, `padron.status()`
- `cdc.constatar(input)`, `cdc.status()`, `cdc.getTiposCbte()`
- `arca.consultarComprobante(tipo, pv, nro)` — resultGet (route spreads it and defaults the optional lists to [])
- `arca.getPuntosVenta()` (not cached; `[]` when the CUIT has none — ARCA's 602, e.g. in homologación — since 7.0.1, so GET /puntos-venta answers 200 `[]` and the UI shows a numeric input), `arca.getTipos*()`, `arca.getCondicionesIva()`, `arca.getCotizacion(monedaId, { fecha })`
- `arca.status()` — WSFE/WSFEX health; `/afip/status` returns `{ wsfe, wsfex }` each `{ ok, status: { appserver, dbserver, authserver } }` or `{ ok: false, error, status? }`
- `wsaa.resetLoginCooldown()` — via POST /afip/wsaa-reset after fixing a permanent WSAA error

## Certificate Management (via arca-cert)

The arca-cert package automates ARCA certificate lifecycle:
- `createCertificate({cuit, password, alias, environment})` — Login to ARCA portal with clave fiscal, generate CSR, get signed cert from WSASS
- `renewCertificate({...})` — Creates new cert with timestamped alias suffix
- `getCertExpiry(certPem)` — Parse X.509 notBefore/notAfter dates
- `authenticate({cert, key, service, environment})` — Test cert against WSAA
- `parseSoapFault(body)` — Parse SOAP faults with contextual hints (e.g., "Estás usando el ambiente correcto?")
- Error handling: ArcaCertError with codes (INVALID_CUIT, LOGIN_FAILED, SESSION_EXPIRED, WSAA_ERROR, CERTIFICATE_ERROR, etc.) mapped to HTTP status codes in errorHandler

## Invoice Types and Rules
- Receptor IVA conditions per class follow what the SDK validates when issuing (class A: RECEPTORES_CLASE_A; class B: RECEPTORES_CLASE_B; tipo 49: consumidor final; validation 10243). `resolverCbteTipo` (not used here) maps RI → 1/6/13/16 to A and the rest to B:
- **Factura A (tipo 1):** receptor condición 1 (RI), 6, 13 or 16 (monotributo). Requires CUIT (DocTipo=80, validated by the SDK since 6.1). Discriminates IVA.
- **Factura B (tipo 6):** receptor condición 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10 or 15 (RECEPTORES_CLASE_B, validated by the SDK since 6.2). DocTipo 99 (sin identificar), 80, 96 or 86. Discriminates IVA.
- **Factura C (tipo 11):** issued by monotributistas/exentos; any receptor condition. Does NOT discriminate IVA (isTipoC).
- **NC/ND (3,8,13 / 2,7,12):** Created from existing approved invoices via notaCredito/notaDebito. Type auto-inferred from original.
- **Receptor IVA condition (RG 5616):** `condicionIva` required when docTipo != 99 (with 99 the SDK sends 5). Taken from the request body, else from the client (`Client.ivaCondition`), else (NC/ND) from the original invoice's stored emission.
- **Service dates:** FchServDesde/FchServHasta/FchVtoPago only required when concepto = Servicios (2) or Productos y Servicios (3).

## Security
- Helmet with CSP (default-src 'self', img-src 'self' data: — the invoice QR is a link to https://www.arca.gob.ar/fe/qr/, not an image), HSTS 1 year, referrer-policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin, frame-ancestors 'none'
- Registration closed after the first user (admin); only admins create users and generate/renew certificates
- `trust proxy` from TRUST_PROXY (Docker Compose: 1, behind nginx) so rate limits see the client IP; backend port published only on 127.0.0.1
- API keys hashed with SHA-256 before storage (max 5 per user, keyHint field for display mask)
- JWT secret required (no default — server crashes on missing; docker-compose uses `${JWT_SECRET:?}` and `${AFIP_CUIT:?}`)
- DATABASE_URL required (no default)
- Rate limiting: 200 req/15min global (all endpoints), 20 req/15min auth-specific (/api/auth/*)
- CORS default: http://localhost:5173 in dev, http://localhost in Docker Compose (not wildcard)
- Body limit: 1MB
- SOAP fault parsing: parseSoapFault() from arca-cert provides human-readable errors with contextual hints
- ArcaCertError codes mapped to HTTP status: INVALID_CUIT→400, LOGIN_FAILED→401, SESSION_EXPIRED→401, PORTAL_ERROR→502, WSAA_ERROR→502, CERTIFICATE_ERROR→422, NETWORK_ERROR→502

## Database (Prisma 7 + PostgreSQL)
- Uses driver adapter (@prisma/adapter-pg) — no Rust engine, pure JS
- Generated client at `src/generated/prisma/` (gitignored, regenerated on npm install via postinstall script)
- Single shared instance via `src/lib/prisma.ts`
- Models:
  - **User**: email (unique), password (bcrypt 12 rounds), name, role (admin/user)
  - **ApiKey**: key (SHA-256 hash, unique, indexed), keyHint (first 12 + last 4 chars), userId, lastUsed
  - **Client**: name, docType, docNumber (indexed), ivaCondition, address, email, phone. Cannot delete if has invoices
  - **Invoice**: cbteTipo+puntoVenta+cbteNro (unique), all IMP fields as Decimal(15,2), cae, caeFchVto, resultado (A approved / P pending-uncertain / C conflict; indexed), qrUrl, monId, monCotiz as Decimal(15,6), observations, emision (Json: operacion, opts with fixed cbteNro+fecha, intento, estado, envios, ultimoMensaje, encontrado)
  - **InvoiceItem**: description, quantity Decimal(15,4), unitPrice Decimal(15,2), ivaId, ivaRate, subtotal, ivaAmount

## Uncertain emission flow (arca-facturacion "Emisión segura")
1. Reserve cbteNro (ultimoComprobante + 1) and fecha (formatDate(arca.wsaa.now())); `armarComprobante` validates offline and returns the `intento`.
2. Persist the Invoice with resultado "P" and `emision` BEFORE sending (a crash mid-send leaves it recoverable).
3. Send. Approved → "A" + CAE + QR. Rejected (ArcaWSFEError / ArcaAuthError incl. 600/601 / ArcaRechazoError) → row deleted, error returned (not issued).
4. Uncertain (ArcaResultadoIncierto, uncertain ArcaSoapError, or 10016 by number) → wait AFIP_RECOVERY_DELAY_MS → `recuperarComprobante(intento)`:
   - autorizado → "A" with the recovered CAE
   - no_emitido → resend ONCE with the same opts (same cbteNro and fecha; safe per README: a late original would make ARCA reject the duplicate). If ARCA rejects the resend (ArcaRechazoError, or ArcaWSFEError except 6xx) → not issued: row deleted, 422. ArcaAuthError (incl. 600/601), 602 or network → stays "P"
   - conflicto → "C" (manual review)
   - ArcaRechazoError (the number exists with the attempt's data but was rejected) → not issued: row deleted, 422
   - no certainty → stays "P"; retry with POST /api/invoices/:id/recuperar
5. While a "P" invoice exists for a (cbteTipo, puntoVenta), new emissions of that pair answer 409.

## Endpoint changes (first migration to the modular SDKs; superseded where noted below)
- New: POST /api/invoices/:id/recuperar, POST /api/afip/sire-emitir (alias /sire-retencion), POST /api/afip/sire-anular (body AnularCertificadoParams), POST /api/afip/empleados-generar?formato=txt (TXT download)
- Removed: POST /api/afip/agro-ctg-solicitar, POST /api/afip/sire-consultar, GET /api/afip/sire-regimenes, DELETE /api/afip/sire-anular/:nro
- Changed: /constatar (cbteModo, cuitEmisor — camelCase since cdc 0.5), /cotizacion (?fecha), /comprobante (arrays), /fecred-* (XSD payloads, fechaEmision query), /mtxca-autorizar (ComprobanteType, R → 422), /padron-status and /agro-status (per-service { ok, status | error }), /contribuyente/:cuit (+ condicionIvaSugerida), /empleados-generar (fixed-width format)

## Endpoint changes (SDK upgrade to facturacion 6.1 / common 0.7, 2026-11) — JSON is now the SDKs' camelCase
- GET /api/afip/status: was `{ AppServer, DbServer, AuthServer }` → `{ wsfe, wsfex }` ServiceStatus with `appserver/dbserver/authserver`
- GET /api/afip/comprobante: PascalCase ResultGet → camelCase resultGet (`cbteFch`, `impTotal`, `impIva`, `iva`, `tributos`, `cbtesAsoc`, `opcionales`, `observaciones`, `events`)
- GET /api/afip/cotizacion: `{ monId, monCotiz, fchCotiz }`; GET /api/afip/puntos-venta: `{ nro, emisionTipo, bloqueado, fchBaja }`; param tables `{ id, desc, fchDesde, fchHasta }`; /cdc-tipos-cbte `{ id, desc }`
- GET /api/afip/last-voucher: `{ cbteNro, ptoVta, cbteTipo }`; GET /api/afip/mtxca-ultimo-comprobante: `{ cbteNro, ptoVta, cbteTipo }`
- POST /api/afip/constatar: camelCase body and result (PascalCase body → 400)
- /padron-status, /agro-status: `{ ok: false, error, status? }` (status when a server is down); /contribuyente adds `metadata`; /mtxca-autorizar adds `urlQR`
- New: POST /api/afip/wsaa-reset; /empleados-generar accepts `fechaReferencia`
- Errors: ArcaAuthError adds `retryable`, `faultCode`, `blocked`; new 409 ArcaConflictoExpo; ArcaResponseError → 502; uncertain ArcaAgroServiceError → 502
- `Invoice.emision.encontrado` (conflicts) stored in camelCase from now on (older rows keep PascalCase)

## API contract changes (audit fixes, 2026-11)
- POST /api/invoices: `concepto` default changed 2 → 1 (Productos), matching the UI
- `aprobada: false` rejections: 400 "AFIP rejected comprobante..." → 422 "ARCA rechazó el comprobante: <code>: <msg>" with `errors`/`details`
- ArcaWSFEError error text: "AFIP rejected the request" → "ARCA rechazó la solicitud: <code>: <msg>"; ZodError: "Validation error" → "Datos inválidos: <path>: <message>"; all user-facing messages in Spanish
- POST /api/auth/register closed after the first user (admin-only afterwards, no token returned); new GET /api/auth/registration-status
- generate-cert / renew-cert: admin-only; reject CUIT ≠ AFIP_CUIT or environment ≠ active (400); default environment = active (was production)
- POST /api/afip/test-cert: default environment = active (was production)
- GET /api/invoices and /api/clients: invalid page/limit (limit > 100) or filters → 400 (were ignored or caused 500)
- New GET /api/afip/config; generate-cert no longer returns `certPath`/`keyPath`; /api/invoices/stats no longer returns `recentInvoices` (unused; the dashboard lists GET /api/invoices) and adds `invoiceCount`, `creditNoteCount`, `debitNoteCount`, `monthlyInvoices` (invoices only), `monthlyCreditNotes`, `monthlyDebitNotes`, `monthlyAmount`, and amounts are net of credit notes

## API contract changes (SDKs with uniform API: facturacion 7 / common 0.9, 2026-11)
- Resultado R of /mtxca-autorizar, /fecred-aceptar, /fecred-rechazar, /sire-emitir, /sire-anular → 422 from errorHandler `{ success: false, code, operacion, error, errors, observaciones }` (was: /mtxca-autorizar 422 with `data: result`; /fecred-* 200 with resultado R)
- POST /api/afip/constatar: `events` → `eventos`
- A pending invoice that recuperarComprobante finds rejected → row deleted, 422 (was "C" conflict)
- Node >= 22.12 (engines `^22.12.0 || >=24.0.0`)

## SDK patch upgrade (facturacion 7.0.1, common 0.9.1, cdc/mtxca/agro 0.8.1, sire 0.7.1, 2026-11)
- GET /api/afip/puntos-venta without puntos de venta → 200 `[]` (was 422 ArcaWSFEError 602)
- GET /api/afip/cdc-tipos-cbte: an empty table (503 "Sin Resultados") is `[]`; CDC events with code 0 are no longer returned
- POST /api/afip/mtxca-autorizar accepts IVA conditions 8 (5%) and 9 (2,5%); No Categorizado without tributo 13 but with another tributo is no longer rejected locally (ARCA observes 150); período on Factura B is rejected locally (162)
- SIRE BAD_SERVICE / CANT_VERIFY_DATA faults → ArcaAuthError 503 (were ArcaSoapError 502 uncertain)

## SDK security release (common 0.10.0, facturacion 7.0.2, padron 0.9.1, cdc/mtxca/agro 0.8.2, fecred 0.8.1, sire 0.7.2, empleados 0.6.1, 2026-11)
- No API change for the server: it uses the SDKs' default (https) endpoints
- SDK transport: redirects are not followed (3xx → ArcaSoapError, 502 via errorHandler), responses capped at 50 MB, DOCTYPE responses rejected, legacy TLS only for servicios1.afip.gov.ar (new `request:legacy-tls` event, logged by onEvent)
- WSAA: TRA validity 10 min (TA still 12 h); FileTicketStorage directory checks (see AFIP_TICKETS_DIR)

## Environment variables (backend)
- Root `.env` (from `.env.example`) is for Docker Compose; `backend/.env` (from `backend/.env.example`) is for local dev
- DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET (required), JWT_EXPIRES_IN (default 7d), PORT (3001), CORS_ORIGIN (comma-separated, default http://localhost:5173), TRUST_PROXY (default false; 1 behind nginx)
- AFIP_CUIT (number or string, check digit validated by the SDKs; generated certificates must match it), AFIP_CERT_PATH, AFIP_KEY_PATH (Docker: /app/certs on the writable named volume arca-certs), AFIP_PUNTO_VENTA, AFIP_PRODUCTION (generated certificates must match its environment)
- AFIP_TICKETS_DIR — WSAA access tickets directory (default backend/certs/tickets; Docker: volume arca-tickets at /app/tickets, owned by appuser 0700). Contains token/sign: treat as secret. Since common 0.10 FileTicketStorage tightens a dir owned by the server user to 0700 and rejects a symlink or a dir owned by another user (auth:storage-error, tickets only in memory → after a restart ArcaTicketVigenteError during WSAA's retention window)
- AFIP_RECOVERY_DELAY_MS — wait before querying an uncertain invoice (default 3000)
- ARCA_INTEGRATION=1 — enables integration tests (with AFIP_CUIT and certs)

## Infra
- docker-compose.yml: postgres (127.0.0.1:5433 on the host), backend (127.0.0.1:3001, volumes arca-certs and arca-tickets), frontend, nginx (APP_PORT)
- nginx: /api/invoices and /api/afip/* proxy_read_timeout 130s (frontend waits up to 120s for emissions, recovery and certificate generation); rest of /api 30s
- Root scripts: setup, dev, dev:backend, dev:frontend, db:up (docker compose up -d postgres), db:migrate, db:generate, db:studio. No seed

- `npm test` (vitest), no network or certificate needed:
  - tests/arca-sdk.test.ts — enums (Moneda 029/031), common formatDate (strict, Argentina timezone), QR (generarUrlQR, urlQRDesdeFactura, ArcaFacturacion.generateQRUrl baseUrl), calcularTotales, armarComprobante + intento and 6.1 validations, condicionIva requirement, requiereRecuperacion(error) with ArcaRechazoError, error classes, CUIT/cert validation in constructors, shared wsaa (and environment mismatch), empleados fixed-width file
  - tests/afip-routes.e2e.test.ts — /api/afip routes with the real arca.service and SDKs, ARCA mocked through fetch: shared WsaaClient, camelCase shapes, WSFE 600 → 503, 602 → 422, constatar, ArcaResponseError → 502, permanent WSAA error blocks until /wsaa-reset, FECRED resultado R → 422 ARCA_RECHAZO
  - tests/arca-service.test.ts — lazy SDKs: boots without certs, 503 on first use
  - tests/auth.routes.test.ts — closed registration (first user admin + token, 403 without credentials or as non-admin, admin creates users without token, registration-status) and 403 on generate/renew-cert for non-admins; real authMiddleware + in-memory Prisma
  - tests/errorHandler.test.ts — HTTP mapping of every SDK error (incl. ArcaRechazoError / ArcaSireServiceError) and instanceof ordering
  - tests/invoice.service.test.ts — emission and uncertain → recover flow with mocked arca.service and in-memory Prisma; ArcaRechazoError on send, recovery and resend
  - tests/afip-empleados.route.test.ts — /empleados-generar JSON and ?formato=txt (ISO-8859-1, Content-Disposition), fechaInicio required, unknown keys, fechaReferencia
  - Integration tests (describe.skipIf, need ARCA_INTEGRATION=1 + AFIP_CUIT + certs): status(), getTipos*, getCotizacion, facturar B + urlQR + recuperarComprobante, consultarComprobante, notaCredito, status().wsfex
